name: game-dev-skills
description: Twelve agent skills that help you plan, build, debug, test, balance, compose music for, and release games, with an optional project profile that points the game skills at your own rules and tests.

interface.longDescription: Twelve skills for building games with an AI coding agent: design planning, balance simulation, playtest analysis, implementation, debugging, usability audits, music composition, documentation cleanup, ship-readiness verification, release checks, continuity across long sessions, and skill auditing. For solo developers and small teams, on any engine or genre. An optional GAME_PROJECT_PROFILE.md in your project points the skills at your own rules, tests, and status files. The three skills with side effects, game-release, game-qa-cleanup, and game-full-verification, are meant to run only when you name them, and game-release stops before publishing until you say to publish.
